step1_analysis.description: A lumped-element equivalent circuit model (pi-model) for a monolithic spiral inductor, capturing series inductance, series resistance, and substrate parasitic capacitances.

paper_reference.title: Analysis of On-Chip Spiral Inductors Using the Distributed Capacitance Model

SRF.description: Self-Resonant Frequency where the inductor transitions from inductive to capacitive (Im(Z) = 0)

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Ls=2nH and total parasitic capacitance Ceq~150fF, SRF = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(L*Ceq))
sky130_expected.reasoning: SRF depends heavily on the inductor geometry (turns, radius, width). 9 GHz is typical for a ~2nH inductor in modern processes.

Peak_Q.description: Maximum Quality Factor (ratio of imaginary to real impedance)

paper_reported.value: Mentioned in text, specific peak values not explicitly listed in the numerical array

sky130_expected.calculation: Q = Im(Z)/Re(Z). Depends on Rs and substrate losses.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical on-chip spiral inductors have peak Q factors between 5 and 15 due to metal resistance and substrate losses.

Leq.description: Equivalent Inductance at low frequency (e.g., 1 GHz)

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by Ls parameter in the model
sky130_expected.reasoning: On-chip inductors typically range from 0.5nH to 10nH for RF applications.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the impedance of the inductor model over frequency to extract Self-Resonant Frequency (SRF), Peak Quality Factor (Q), and Equivalent Inductance (Leq).
step3_testbench.spice:
* On-Chip Spiral Inductor Model Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param Ls_val=2n Rs_val=2 Cp_val=50f Csub_val=100f Rsub_val=100

* DUT
Csub IN N1 {Csub_val}
Rsub N1 GND {Rsub_val}
Cp IN GND {Cp_val}
Ls IN N2 {Ls_val}
Rs N2 GND {Rs_val}

* AC Current Source for Impedance Measurement (Z = V(IN)/1 = V(IN))
I1 GND IN AC 1

.control
* AC analysis from 100 MHz to 20 GHz
ac dec 100 100MEG 20G

* Calculate Impedance, Q, and Leq
let Z = v(IN)
let ReZ = real(Z)
let ImZ = imag(Z)
let Q = ImZ / ReZ
let omega = 2 * pi * frequency
let Leq = ImZ / omega

* Measure Self-Resonant Frequency (SRF)
meas ac srf when ImZ=0 fall=1

* Measure Peak Q and Frequency at Peak Q
meas ac max_Q max Q
meas ac freq_max_Q MAX_AT Q

* Measure Equivalent Inductance at 1 GHz
meas ac Leq_1G find Leq at=1G

print srf max_Q freq_max_Q Leq_1G
quit
.endc
.end
